prompt_head:
Role: Solutions Architect at Kobie
<requirements>
[r1] (required, years_experience) 3-5 years of experience in solutions architecture, business requirements ana

assessments.note: Systems Architect roles over about 4 years include integration blueprints and client onboarding.
Project management certification and drafted documents, but no BRDs, SCDs, or Epic briefs shown.
Validation pipelines shown, but no delivery cost estimate or COGS validation work.
No Agile, Scrum, waterfall, or iterative delivery methodology is shown.
Built an AI demo generator, but no RFP, RFI, or proposal materials shown.
Client onboarding and integration work shown, but no cross-workstream dependency coordination.
Error-reduction pipelines are adjacent, but no scope drift or corrective action plans shown.
No loyalty marketing program or mechanics experience is shown.
No retail, financial services, or travel and hospitality delivery experience is shown.
CRM module experience is adjacent, but no MarTech campaign, CDP, or personalization tools shown.
No evidence of travel experience or stated willingness to travel quarterly.
Based in South Florida, but no remote or hybrid arrangement or St. Petersburg tie shown.

output.verdict_line: The candidate shows strong systems architecture and AI agent experience but lacks evidence of delivery methodologies, loyalty marketing, and COGS validation.
top_gaps: Business requirements documentation into BRDs, SCDs, and Epic/Feature briefs
Agile/Scrum, waterfall, and iterative delivery methodology experience
